description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for retrieving and processing equity profile data from Finviz, including query parameters, data structures, and data extraction logic.

classes.name: FinvizEquityProfileQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Finviz equity profile requests, allowing multiple symbols.

classes.name: FinvizEquityProfileData
classes.description: Data model representing the equity profile information retrieved from Finviz.

classes.name: FinvizEquityProfileFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class responsible for retrieving and processing equity profile data from Finviz.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FinvizEquityProfileQueryParams instance.

methods.name: extract_data
methods.description: Fetches raw equity profile data from Finviz for given symbols, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Validates and converts raw data dictionaries into FinvizEquityProfileData instances.
